subject: reasoning
question: If 13 December 1969 is Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 9 July 1978?
solution:
Given : 13 December 1969 was Saturday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 13 December 1969 to 9 July 1978 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 1969
 13 December 1969 - 31 December 1969
 18 days
 18 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 1970 - 2077
 Full years (6 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 6 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 2 Leap years) = 10 odd days
 10 ÷ 7 = 3
 
 

 1978
 1st January 1978 - 9 July 1978
 31 January + 28 February + 31 March + 30 April + 31 May + 30 June + 9 July = 190 days 
 190 ÷ 7 = 1
 
 

 Total odd days
 (8 ÷ 7) = **1**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 13 December 1969 to 9 July 1978 ⇒ 1

⇒So, One odd day get added to Saturday because day asked in future.

∴ Sunday was the day of the week on the 9 July 1978.

Hence, "**Sunday**" is the correct answer.
